def factor_volume_skew_range_tension(df):
    """Nonlinear fusion of volume skewness and normalized intraday range."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    range_ratio = (df_copy["high"] - df_copy["low"]) / df_copy["close"]
    range_ratio = range_ratio.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0)
    vol_skew = df_copy["volume"].rolling(20, min_periods=5).skew()
    vol_skew = vol_skew.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0)
    range_nl = np.tanh(range_ratio * 20.0)
    factor = range_nl * vol_skew
    df_copy["factor_volume_skew_range_tension"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_volume_skew_range_tension"]
description: Rolling skewness of volume captures asymmetric trading activity: positive skew means occasional large volume spikes amid quiet baseline, often linked to information arrivals or liquidity shocks. Multiplying by tanh of normalized high-low range creates a nonlinear feature that amplifies volume distribution asymmetry when intraday price range is wide. This raw signal should survive industry/size neutralization by focusing on idiosyncratic volume and price tension.
